title: Bleeth
tagline: Liquidity betting protocol based on vampire attacks as primitive
description: Bleeth.me is a cornerstone protocol that systematizes the DeFi liquidity wars while enabling DeFi protocols to reduce their mercenary liquidity providers. Its core mechanic is built around Vampire Attack (VA) Pools. A VA Pool can be created permissionlessly by anyone to initiate a deliberately targeted liquidity-stealing attack against a competitor protocol. Additionally, to protect against mercenary liquidity, a configurable lockup period can be specified to ensure that the funds remain deposited as liquidity in the destination protocol for a predetermined amount of time.
